title: Bill Gates says to prepare for 20 years of ‘tumultuous’ AI disruption
hook_text: Bill Gates predicts twenty years of disruption
script:
Bill Gates expects twenty years of tumultuous AI disruption across the global economy.
The Microsoft cofounder published his essay titled The turbulent AI era in late August.
He has spent months on tour discussing policy and regulation for OpenAI and Anthropic models.
Gates warns that rapid labor shifts will strain social systems before markets finally stabilize.
Governments must build new safety policies now to manage this transition effectively.
Would you change careers because of AI?
